narrative_purpose: Makes foundation-species loss visible as a suite of linked physical changes, not merely missing trees: removing hemlock opens light, warms soil and stream, accelerates litter decay and loses shade specialists.
subject: The same Appalachian headwater plot before and after eastern hemlock death. In the intact half, dense evergreen crowns create deep cool shade over thick acidic litter and a narrow clear stream; a black-throated green warbler forages in the dim branches. In the girdled half, standing trunks carry a clean ring cut through the bark, crowns are thinning, harsh shafts reach a warm exposed floor, leaf litter is visibly decomposing into patchy dark soil, runoff enters a brighter warmer stream, and the specialist bird is absent while a generalist bird occupies a birch sapling.
scene: Harvard Forest experimental plots shown at matched season, topography and weather, separated by a narrow survey corridor with no signage.
camera: Wide eye-level forest cross-section following the stream across both plots.
light: Intact hemlock side stays cool indigo-teal; removal side receives a controlled pale amber daylight intrusion while cyan water links the two.
palette: Cool indigo, hemlock teal and cyan stream dominate; restrained amber only on the newly exposed floor and warming water.
style: Painterly forest-ecology experiment with faithful eastern hemlock form and legible microclimate contrast.
detail_level: Crisp girdling cut, litter, stream edge and bird niches; distant trunks soften.
composition: Intact shaded plot left, girdled opening right, the same stream running continuously across the lower third. Preserve dark canopy and open floor generous deep indigo negative space.
consistency_notes: The experimental treatment is bark girdling with trees left standing, not logging. Show multiple linked microclimate effects and a change in bird occupancy without depicting instant total forest death.
negative_prompt: no text, no arrows, no clear-cut, no chainsaws, no dramatic fire, no tropical forest, no photo or CGI look
